# Hoberg Jobs

> Hoberg Jobs (https://jobs.hoberg.com.ng) is a verified remote job discovery and career advancement platform built by Hoberg Digital Agency (https://hoberg.com.ng).

## Core Capabilities
- **Verified Remote Job Discovery**: Real-time aggregated remote vacancies across Customer Support, Virtual Assistance, Writing & Content, Finance, Marketing, Design, and Software Engineering worldwide (including Nigeria & Africa).
- **1-Click Google Authentication**: Fast, secure account creation and sign in via Google OAuth.
- **Application & Saved Jobs Tracking**: User dashboard for bookmarking opportunities, tracking application stages, and editing professional career profiles.
- **Hoberg Premium**: Curated exclusive remote career opportunities with direct recruiter tips and Paystack billing in Nigerian Naira (₦4,000/mo Founding Member / ₦5,000/mo standard).
- **Legitimate Employer Protection**: Zero fees required to apply for jobs; all listings link directly to official employer career portals.

- Homepage: https://jobs.hoberg.com.ng/

- Customer Care, Support & Client Relations
